description: Small original qualification fixture, not a general dictionary. No third-party definitions copied.

reader.definition: A person who reads, or an application used to read documents.

page.definition: One numbered surface or section of a document.

document.definition: A recorded piece of writing or other information.

test.definition: A check used to discover whether something works as intended.

device.definition: An object made to perform a particular task.

inkbound.definition: The name of this experimental document reader.

café.definition: A small place serving drinks and light food. Unicode normalization test entry.

can't.definition: A shortened form of cannot. Apostrophe handling test entry.
